summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. furnishing its annual financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The report includes consolidated and separate financial statements, notes, and audit reports, but does not disclose any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. This is a standard periodic financial report required of foreign private issuers under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No deal terms or event-driven action is present.
